notes: This is al-Saduq's own statement of his routes («رويته عن ...») to Hariz: no saying follows, so it is the route-ruling case of rule 11
«- رضي اللّه عنه -» blessings are left out; «أبي» is the compiler's own father and «أبيه» is his father's name's bare kinship word: both relation links
Two routes to Hariz: the first (via محمد بن الحسن الصفار) and the second (via علي بن إبراهيم); the names are not merged
